activity.notes: Pakistan's National Assembly records Jinnah as unanimously elected President of the first Constituent Assembly on 11 August 1947 and lists his tenure through 11 September 1948. This legislative-constitutional office overlapped with his Governor-Generalship and is therefore recorded as a distinct concurrent Activity.

sources.title: National Assembly of Pakistan - Presiding Officers
sources.citation_text: Official National Assembly list gives Jinnah's Constituent Assembly presidency as 11 August 1947 to 11 September 1948.
